scripts.dev: npm run sample && nx run database:migrate && nx run frontend:dev
scripts.build: npm run sample && nx run-many -t build
scripts.types: wrangler types --config wrangler.jsonc --config wrangler.backend.jsonc && wrangler types projects/backend/worker-configuration.d.ts --config wrangler.backend.jsonc --env-interface BackendEnv --include-runtime false
scripts.format: prettier --write projects shared tests scripts *.json *.jsonc *.ts *.md docs/*.md
scripts.check: npm run check:boundaries && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
